description: Search places by a free-text query matching name, address, or type.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Google-style envelope with a results list of matching places; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the full details of a single place by its place_id.

place_id.description: The unique place_id of the place.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Google-style envelope with the place result; on failure (place not found), output contains an error message.

description: Find places within a radius of a resolved location, optionally filtered by type.

location.description: A 'lat,lng' pair, place name, geocode query, or place_id to center the search on.

place_type.description: Optional place type to filter results by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Google-style envelope with a distance-sorted results list; on failure (location not resolvable), output contains an error message.

description: Resolve an address or place string into coordinates and a formatted address.

address.description: The address, place name, or geocode query to resolve.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. Output is a Google-style envelope with a results list (empty when zero results).

description: Compute a route between an origin and destination for a given travel mode.

origin.description: The origin as a 'lat,lng' pair, place name, geocode query, or place_id.

destination.description: The destination as a 'lat,lng' pair, place name, geocode query, or place_id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Google-style envelope with a routes list; on failure (endpoint not resolvable), output contains an error message.

description: Compute a distance/duration matrix between lists of origins and destinations.

origins.description: List of origin strings (each a 'lat,lng' pair, place name, geocode query, or place_id).

destinations.description: List of destination strings (each a 'lat,lng' pair, place name, geocode query, or place_id).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. Output is a Google-style envelope with origin_addresses, destination_addresses, and a rows matrix of distance/duration elements.
